subject: english
title: Unit 1 Writing App — Safe not Sorry! (personal narrative)
subtitle: Companion to the Writing deck: 🎴 Vocab Foundations (senses · emotions · experience; the five senses · forecaster · heavy) · 📘 Student Book (personal narrative, key expressions, plan, write, edit & share) · 📓 Workbook pp. 10–11 (7 steps, plan, express yourself, events in order, second story) · ⚽ final quiz. 13 modules.

content: Read the model “Safe not Sorry!” (SB p. 18) part by part and answer the SB Activity 1 questions.
Find the writer’s 12 sense and emotion words and 7 time words in the model.
Plan a storm story in a senses-and-emotions chart, then write a personal narrative with a first sentence, events in order and a closing sentence.
Edit with the checklist and fix irregular past tense verbs.
Complete WB pp. 10–11: the writer’s 7 steps, the planning chart, Express Yourself, events in order and a second narrative.
language: Use the academic words senses, emotions and experience.
Use sight, sound, touch, taste, smell, forecaster and heavy.
Use time words: first, next, then, when, soon, suddenly, before, after.
Use irregular past tense verbs: told, saw, went, came, heard, shook.
